summary: Tested Integrity Audit feature (backend + frontend admin UI). 22/22 backend pytest pass (10 new audit + 12 regression on manual_upgrade_debit). Frontend admin dashboard exposes the new red 'Audit d'integrite' CTA and the /audit page renders 3 tabs, auto-loads /free-activations and /orphan-commissions with the expected structure. Trace tab UI present; trace endpoint validated via pytest (404 on unknown user, full structure on admin id).
critical_code_review_comments: integrity_audit.py commission_id is built from c.get('_id') but the query already excludes '_id' via projection {'_id':0} => commission_id will always be None. Consider projecting id or using c.get('id').
audit-tab-orphan-commissions cards show 'Creditee a: f3314320...' (truncated user id) but no username lookup; adding recipient username would improve readability for admins.

activate_level() computes requires_payment as level>=2 OR source not in ('admin_manual',) which is True even for external paid sources at L1 (soleaspay/gateway_return). Logically fine (they DO pay) but the flag name suggests 'this activation required payment'; document semantics or store `payment_required=True/False` more precisely per source.
Free-activations audit only lists rows where a finding exists; when max_level=0 users exist they are skipped correctly. Consider adding a summary of scanned users count for observability.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all testIDs found, page navigates and data loads)

seed_data_creation: test_admin_manual_l1_creates_activation_event registers a TEST_audit_<uid> user via /api/auth/register, admin activates L1 via /api/admin/users/{id}/action, verifies activation_events entry, then best-effort DELETE. 2 residual TEST users appeared in the /free-activations findings during the frontend run (Info L1 severity) — expected because DELETE endpoint returned non-2xx in this preview. Admin can clean up via DB or admin panel.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests are in /app/backend/tests/test_integrity_audit.py — run with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL exported. Two TEST_audit_* users may remain in the DB (Info L1 findings). The /audit page path in expo router is `/audit` (group '(admin)' is stripped). Frontend needs the audit button to be scrolled into view before clicking; use scrollIntoView({block:'center'}) before playwright click.
rca of the issue: N/A - feature verification, no bugs found. Original production bug (activations without payment, orphan commissions) is now diagnosable through the 3 read-only endpoints, and the /orphan-commissions scan in preview already flags 8/10 legacy commissions with 'from_user_id does not exist' (expected: those users were previously deleted in test churn). The admin can now identify the same pattern in prod.
